baseline_models.mechanism: Causative entry crosses a boundary into a tree-covered interior, while faith contributes the security appropriate to inhabiting it.

activation_trace.role: Literal inward entry supplies the boundary-crossing transfer.
Heart-security supplies the condition that answers exposure and fear.
A garden screened by dense growth makes the destination an inhabitable shelter.

changed_reading.before: The reward is simply possession of pleasant gardens.
changed_reading.after: The reward is a divinely effected transfer from exposure into a secure, sheltering interior.

baseline_models.mechanism: Trusted assent settles the heart, becomes intentional work, and takes the form of repair or fitness rather than remaining an inward claim.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inward orientation.
Purposive action converts assent into an intended practice.
Repair opposed to corruption gives the practice its operative direction.
Fitness for a purpose adds situational adequacy to generic goodness.

changed_reading.before: Belief and good deeds form a generic eligibility list.
changed_reading.after: Settled trust becomes purposive repair fitted to the world it acts within.

baseline_models.mechanism: The visible, screening garden is maintained by moving water in channels below it; the reward is therefore a layered life-system whose support remains active and partly hidden.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment make the flourishing surface a screened layer.
Continuous running supplies the active movement sustaining the scene.
The lower spatial layer locates support beneath what is seen.
A watercourse cutting through earth gives the moving water durable channels.
Opening and widening until flow is possible makes the channel a life-enabling aperture.

changed_reading.before: The rivers decorate an otherwise static garden.
changed_reading.after: The garden is a layered ecology whose visible shelter depends on continuing, channelled movement below.

baseline_models.mechanism: Human beings perform intentional repair, but God alone effects admission and realizes what is willed; the two agencies cooperate without becoming equivalent.

activation_trace.role: Human intended work supplies responsive agency.
God's causative entry supplies the result humans cannot self-install.
Effective bringing-about grounds the result in realized divine action.
Will and intention provide the directing end of that effective action.

changed_reading.before: The garden follows mechanically as wages for human work.
changed_reading.after: Human repair matters, but admission and the resulting order remain acts of effective divine will.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's inert-earth-to-growth sequence turns the focus's water below the garden into a resurrection mechanism: water reaches dead substrate, motion begins, and life emerges.

activation_trace.role: Running water supplies the continuing current to be causally activated.
Earth-cutting watercourses provide the channels through which revival can persist.
Dry lifelessness supplies the dormant substrate before water acts.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the initiating transfer into the earth.
Earth and plant stirring into life marks the first visible response.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the completed life-producing outcome.

structural_cues: 22:5 orders dormant earth, descending water, movement, swelling, and growth.
22:6-7 immediately read that sequence through enlivening the dead and raising the buried.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the revival sequence and the focus supplies current below growth; I infer that the current is the garden's ongoing resurrection engine. A live alternative is that 22:5 is only an external analogy for resurrection, not an internal account of the garden.

changed_reading.after: They are the active medium by which dead ground is continually made capable of garden life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The edge-worshipper rests only when benefit arrives and reverses under testing; this negative sequence sharpens focus-faith into durable inward security rather than circumstance-rented calm.

activation_trace.role: Security and heart-rest supply the positive focus anchor.
Directional deflection supplies the marginal, unstable orientation of worship at an edge.
Literal tranquility supplies a calm shown to depend on favorable impact.
Assaying a person like material supplies the pressure that reveals the calm's quality.
Turning something back from its face supplies the reversal that exposes conditional trust.

structural_cues: 22:11 pairs benefit with tranquility and trial with reversal in a balanced conditional construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional calm and reversal; I infer that the focus's faith names the contrary capacity to remain inwardly settled through changed conditions. A live alternative is that faith here marks communal identification without specifying psychological durability.

changed_reading.before: Those who believe are those who assent.
changed_reading.after: Those who believe possess a security not leased from favorable circumstances and therefore capable of surviving assay.

context_deltas.mechanism: Desired admission into a garden is inverted by desired exit from a covered distress: the latter repeatedly fails and is returned inward, making inside, outside, and who controls passage central to the focus.

activation_trace.role: Causative inward passage supplies the focus's granted transition.
Will and intention make the prisoners' outward vector explicit.
Passage to an exterior supplies the attempted inverse of admission.
Covering and enclosure make the punitive interior itself oppressive.
Return after departure closes the attempted exit and restores confinement.

structural_cues: 22:22 places willing, exiting, distress, and forced return in one compact loop.
22:23 then repeats the focus admission formula as the immediate positive counterpart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent opposite passage-vectors; I infer a deliberate inside/outside contrast governed by divine agency. A live alternative is that the adjacency contrasts outcomes without making passage itself thematic.

changed_reading.before: Admission means arrival at a pleasant place.
changed_reading.after: Admission is one side of sovereignty over passage: gifted entry into shelter contrasts with failed self-extraction from punitive enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fire-clothing, melted interiors, and skins are answered by the repeated garden formula followed by adornment and silk; garden admission thus carries a bodily re-clothing contrast, not merely a change of scenery.

activation_trace.role: The screened garden supplies the positive environment for re-embodiment.
Clothing as bodily covering supplies the hostile exterior layer made from fire.
The body's inside supplies the inward layer reached by the punishment.
Skin as bodily envelope supplies the outer layer paired with the interior.
Covering with clothing supplies the restored positive exterior.
Fine silk specifies the gentle material of that counter-covering.

structural_cues: 22:19-20 move from imposed clothing to bodily interior and skin.
22:23 repeats 22:14 almost verbatim and immediately adds adornment and clothing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored coverings around a repeated admission formula; I infer that placement in the garden includes restored inside-outside embodiment. A live alternative is a conventional reward-punishment contrast with no reconstitution mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The garden is an external reward landscape.
changed_reading.after: Garden admission also reverses a violated body-world relation by re-covering the person in a fitting, gentle exterior.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ritual provision is eaten and fed onward, especially to the poor, while flesh and blood do not reach God; the focus's righteous work and flowing abundance become a circulation of received gift through vulnerable bodies.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption anchors the circulation as righteous practice.
Continuing provision and giving let literal flow host a social allocation analogy.
An allotted gift supplies what enters the human distribution circuit.
Feeding another turns received material into outward sustaining action.
Material need identifies the body toward which provision must move.
Wealth going out in expenditure supplies the release side of circulation.
Repeated reaching, denied to flesh and affirmed for piety, separates material transfer from ethical orientation.

structural_cues: 22:28 and 22:36 pair eating with feeding others.
22:37 denies that flesh or blood reaches God and redirects attention to piety.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, feeding, expenditure, and a rejected upward material transfer; I infer a lateral human flow that makes received abundance socially fruitful. A live alternative is that these acts merely exemplify righteous deeds without interpreting the focus's river-flow.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are private moral credits rewarded by abundant water.
changed_reading.after: Righteous practice keeps bestowed provision moving through a community, so abundance becomes life only when it is not dammed at the recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expulsion from homes, later establishment on earth, migration, and death culminate in a promised entrance that satisfies; focus-admission becomes reparative resettlement for people whose earthly place was taken or left.

activation_trace.role: Inward admission supplies the focus's destination-transfer.
Forced passage outside supplies the dispossessing inverse of admission.
Belonging to and residing in a home specifies what expulsion removes.
Being enabled and given capacity supplies provisional re-establishment on earth.
Movement from one dwelling to another extends displacement through migration.
The doubled entry expression makes a new destination explicit after migration and death.
Acceptance opposed to resentment marks the new entrance as genuinely fitting to its inhabitants.

structural_cues: 22:38-41 move from defense of believers through expulsion to establishment on earth.
22:58-59 move from migration and death to provision and a satisfying entrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated exile-to-placement arc; I infer that 22:14's admission repairs dispossession by granting a fitting home. A live alternative is that the later entrance is only a generic afterlife destination unrelated to the earlier loss of dwellings.

changed_reading.before: The garden is a prize added to an intact life.
changed_reading.after: The garden is reparative habitation for people displaced from earthly homes, including those who die before resettlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ruined settlement couples collapsed roofs with an abandoned well and a raised palace; against it, garden plus running rivers becomes an inhabited water-order in which gathering, canopy, and water remain connected and useful.

activation_trace.role: A tree-covered inhabited enclosure supplies the living counter-space.
Active watercourses supply functioning water infrastructure.
People gathered into a settlement supply the social unit that can be emptied.
Water gathered in a settled place links habitation to retained water.
Collapse and falling turn built shelter into an inverted ruin.
A raised roof or canopy supplies the failed upper structure.
The excavated well supplies water infrastructure without active community use.
Vacancy and disablement sever the well from the life it should support.

structural_cues: 22:45 compresses empty settlement, collapsed superstructure, idle well, and elevated palace into one ruin tableau.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed settlement-water architecture; I infer that the focus's garden and rivers form its functioning counter-habitat. A live alternative is that the ruin tableau warns independently and is not meant to define the garden.

changed_reading.after: They signify a durable inhabited order where shelter and water remain joined, unlike the well-equipped but lifeless ruined city.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact believer-and-righteous-work cohort later receives forgiveness plus noble provision, preventing a wage-only reading: repaired action does not imply an unblemished record, and the outcome remains bestowed generosity.

activation_trace.role: Trusted assent identifies the repeated recipient cohort.
Purposive work supplies the human contribution that could be mistaken for a wage basis.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer from effects inserts mercy into the outcome.
An allotted gift frames the outcome as provision rather than earned equivalence.
Honored generosity qualifies the provision as exceeding bare payment.

structural_cues: 22:50 repeats the focus's faith-and-righteous-work phrase but pairs it with both forgiveness and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same cohort with forgiveness and generous provision; I infer that 22:14 cannot be a strict deed-for-garden exchange. A live alternative is that forgiveness and garden reward address separate liabilities without changing the reward logic.

changed_reading.before: Righteous work earns admission by equivalence.
changed_reading.after: Righteous work is real but non-exhaustive: admission joins repaired practice to forgiveness and generous provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: An intrusive casting is removed and the signs are consolidated; testing differentiates hearts, after which recognition of truth becomes faith and low-settled receptivity. Focus-faith can therefore be a stabilized result of filtering, not untouched certainty.

activation_trace.role: Assent in which the heart rests anchors the resulting faith-state.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the filtering operation.
Consolidation into a secure, exact form supplies stabilization after removal.
Assay of material and person supplies the differentiating pressure on hearts.
A low, calm, open tract supplies the heart's receptive settling after recognition.
The heart itself is the interior site where filtering becomes settled faith.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders intrusion, removal, and consolidation.
22:53-54 then divide diseased or hardened hearts from knowledgeable hearts that believe and settle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies textual filtering and differentiated heart responses; I infer an analogous epistemic process in the focus's believers. A live alternative is that the sequence describes revelation history only and should not be transferred to individual faith formation.

changed_reading.before: Faith is certainty that never encounters contaminating noise.
changed_reading.after: Faith may be the settled state produced when intrusion is tested, removed, and truth is allowed to take firm interior form.

context_deltas.mechanism: God inserts night and day into each other, sends water that greens earth, makes a ship run by command, and holds the sky; focus-admission and river-flow become local instances of continuous ingress, circulation, and restraint across a maintained cosmos.

activation_trace.role: Admission into an interior supplies the local human-scale ingress.
Running current supplies the local human-scale circulation.
One thing entering the inside of another generalizes ingress to the night-day cycle.
Daylight opening against night cross-activates the focus's river root with cyclical visibility.
Delivery downward supplies the vertical ingress of water.
Water as material medium supplies what crosses from sky to earth.
Fresh green growth displays the life-result of that ingress.
The ship's running extends the focus-current from water itself to conveyance upon water.
Binding direction by command supplies governance of the motion.
Holding and restraining supplies the stabilizing counterpart to flow.

structural_cues: 22:61 repeats reciprocal ingress at cosmic scale.
22:63 links downward water to green earth.
22:65 pairs commanded running below with restrained falling above.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ingress, flow, and holding; I infer that 22:14 depicts one maintained subsystem within that governance. A live alternative is that these later signs demonstrate power generally without specifying how garden life is sustained.

changed_reading.before: God wills a destination and places people there once.
changed_reading.after: Admission belongs to an ongoing divine practice of inserting, moving, and holding elements so that habitable order persists.

context_deltas.mechanism: Invoked rivals cannot create even a fly or retrieve what it takes, whereas God is described through capacity and concentrated strength; the focus's doing-what-is-willed is an efficacy claim, not bare voluntarism.

activation_trace.role: Actual bringing-about supplies the focus's claim of realized action.
Will supplies the intended end whose realizability is being tested.
Origination supplies the minimal act the invoked rivals cannot perform.
Extracting something from another's grasp supplies the failed recovery test.
Lack of strength diagnoses both seeker and sought as ineffective.
Searching for an outcome supplies desire without power to secure it.
Capacity that reaches action and mastery supplies the positive contrast.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies concentrated effective power.

structural_cues: 22:73 stages creation and recovery as concrete capability tests.
22:74 answers the failure with divine capacity and strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed rival intentions and successful divine capacity; I infer that the focus's will clause emphasizes executable will. A live alternative is that the clause stresses freedom of choice more than efficacy.

changed_reading.before: God does whatever God chooses, with emphasis on unconstrained preference.
changed_reading.after: God's willing is effectual: unlike weak desire, it can originate, recover, admit, and maintain the intended order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing address directly reconnects believers with bodily worship, doing beneficial good, durable success, and protective attachment to God; it functions as a practical gloss on the focus's compact faith-and-righteous-work phrase.

activation_trace.role: Purposive work supplies the compact focus category to be unpacked.
Repair opposed to corruption sets the standard for the unpacked acts.
The repeated believer address identifies the same recipient posture.
Bringing good into action prevents the closing exhortation from remaining abstract.
Inclination toward what benefits gives the action an outwardly useful direction.
Success joined to lastingness supplies the hoped-for durable outcome.
A grip that prevents and preserves supplies the sustaining attachment behind the practice.

structural_cues: 22:77 addresses believers and sequences bowing, prostration, worship, doing good, and flourishing.
22:78 extends the sequence through striving, witness, prayer, alms, and holding fast to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a closing believer-address with concrete acts and preserving attachment; I infer that it expands the focus's righteous works into an integrated practice. A live alternative is that it is a separate exhortation rather than an intended gloss on 22:14.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds are an unspecified moral remainder.
changed_reading.after: They are an integrated embodied practice of worship, beneficial action, social obligation, and sustained reliance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the fetus branch of the garden root and transfers the surah's womb sequence to the destination; it remains anchored in جَنَّاتٍ, inward admission, and 22:5's settled creation in a womb. Render only as a womb-like re-creation analogy, never as a claim that جَنَّاتٍ literally means wombs.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies the enclosing transition.
A fetus hidden within a belly supplies the distant but anchored gestational image.
A generative drop within the water range supplies the small fluid beginning.
Fixing and settling supplies protected persistence during formation.
The female womb supplies the explicit context enclosure for staged creation.
Origination supplies the transformation occurring inside the enclosure.

changed_reading.before: The garden is only an external destination after resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, admission into its concealed, watered interior can resemble a second gestation in which life is re-formed and securely brought forth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because one root is activated across river and daylight senses; it remains anchored by ن ه ر in both 22:14 and 22:61 and by parallel verbs of inward entry. Render as a controlled resonance of opening and renewed visibility, not as a lexical merger of rivers with daytime.

activation_trace.role: Inward entry supplies the focus-side transition between states.
A flowing channel cut through earth supplies the hydrological sense.
Opening and widening until flow is possible supplies the shared aperture image.
Mutual entry of one state into another supplies the cosmic transition.
Daylight opening between dawn and sunset supplies the visible-state branch.

changed_reading.before: The rivers are solely channels of water beneath vegetation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their opened channels can echo day being inserted into night: concealed flow becomes an aperture through which life and visibility renew.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the land-tilling branch of ف ل ح back into the focus's deed-and-garden relation; it remains anchored by 22:77's direct sequence 'do good' then 'flourish' and by the focus's work, repair, and gardens. Render as an agricultural mechanism for ethical formation, not as an etymological claim that every use of فلاح means plowing.

activation_trace.role: Purposive work supplies the human labor side of cultivation.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies cultivation's restorative aim.
A densely planted garden supplies the resulting cultivated habitat.
Doing beneficial action supplies the explicit closing imperative.
Movement toward benefit specifies what the cultivation should grow.
The farmer who cuts open earth supplies the exploratory cultivation mechanism.
Winning joined to lastingness supplies the ethical harvest toward which the labor tends.

changed_reading.before: Deeds qualify recipients for a garden that is otherwise unrelated to their action.
changed_reading.after: Ethical work can be carried as cultivation: it cuts into resistant ground, repairs it, and tends toward a lasting garden-harvest.

strongest_changes: Below-flowing water became an active resurrection ecology rather than decorative abundance.
Faith became durable interior security tested against the edge-worshipper's conditional calm and reversal.
Admission became reparative resettlement and controlled passage, sharpened by expulsion, migration, death, and failed exit.
Righteous work became circulating provision and integrated beneficial practice rather than private moral credit.
Divine will became executable systems-governance: it admits, moves, holds, creates, and restores where rival desire cannot.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly re-opened the compact focus formula: the near-verbatim 22:23 repetition added bodily covering, 22:45 supplied a ruined water-city counter-image, 22:50 inserted forgiveness into the same cohort's outcome, 22:58-59 turned entry into resettlement after displacement and death, 22:61-65 scaled entry and flow to cosmic process, and 22:77 made beneficial action culminate in a cultivation-tinged flourishing.
remaining_uncertainties: The ruined-settlement counter-habitat is spatially coherent but may be juxtaposition rather than an intended definition of the garden.
The filtering model may describe revelation history without licensing a full transfer to individual faith formation.
The womb, day-river, and cultivation activations are branch-backed but should remain explicitly exploratory in downstream prose.
